ev-account.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with the same account as before, so your pack credits are there.

ev-account.damaged-named.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with <email>, the same account as before, so your pack credits are there.

ev-account.packs-unread.say: Your chosen packs could not be read just now. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.not-set-up.say: This machine is not set up for Evalation yet. Run /ev-start to set it up.

ev-account.unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-account again. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong, so Evalation refused it. Set the clock to the right time, then run /ev-account again.

ev-account.refused.say: Evalation no longer accepts this machine. Contact support@evalation.ai and we will sort it out.

ev-account.ended.say: This machine's access to Evalation has ended. To renew it, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.other.say: Evalation could not confirm this machine just now. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.awaiting.say: Your request to use <whose> Evalation credits is waiting for <owner> to approve it. You can run Evalation once they do.

ev-account.machine-awaiting.say: This machine is waiting for <owner> to approve it. You can run Evalation on it once they do.

ev-account.machine-declined.say: <organisation> declined this machine, so you can't run Evalation on it. If you think that's a mistake, ask its owner, <owner>.

ev-account.declined.say: <organisation> declined your request to use its Evalation credits, so you can't run Evalation. If you think that's a mistake, ask its owner, <owner>.

ev-account.removed.say: <organisation> removed you, so you can't use its Evalation credits any more. If you think that's a mistake, ask its owner, <owner>.

ev-account.credits-unread.say: Your pack credits could not be read just now. Run /ev-account again in a minute.

ev-account.no-packs.say: A pack is one thing your code is checked against, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, a security hardening review, or a review for a cyber insurer or investor. You can pick several. Run /ev-packs to choose yours.

ev-account.chosen.say: You chose <titles>. A run against them uses <count> pack credits, one for each pack it reads. Run /ev-run in a repository to check it against them.

ev-account.chosen-one.say: You chose <titles>. A run against it uses one pack credit. Run /ev-run in a repository to check it against that pack.

ev-account.short.say: You chose <titles>. A run against them needs <count> pack credits, more than you have, so it would not start and no pack credits are used. To run it, buy more pack credits or choose fewer packs with /ev-packs.

ev-account.short-one.say: You chose <titles>. A run against it needs one pack credit, more than you have, so it would not start and no pack credits are used. To run it, buy pack credits.

ev-account.buy-ask.ask: Buy pack credits? They're <price> each, and nothing is charged until you pay on Stripe's page. To buy another number, pick Other and type it.

ev-account.buy-count-means.say: Opens Stripe's payment page for <count> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-talk-means.say: Ask about pack credits before you decide.

ev-account.buy-talk-open.say: A run uses one pack credit for each pack it reads. What would you like to know before you buy?

ev-account.buy-opened.say: Stripe's payment page is open in your browser. Once you've paid, run /ev-account to see your new balance. If the page didn't open, go to <url>

ev-account.buy-open-yourself.say: Your browser didn't open, so open Stripe's payment page yourself. Once you've paid, run /ev-account to see your new balance. The page is at <url>

ev-account.buy-not-a-number.say: Type a whole number of pack credits, such as 10.

ev-account.buy-too-few.say: One payment has to be for at least <least> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-too-many.say: One payment can be for up to <most> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-no-price.say: Pack credits aren't on sale here yet. Run /ev-account again later to buy them.

ev-account.buy-unavailable.say: Evalation can't take payments just now. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes to buy pack credits.

ev-account.buy-refused.say: Evalation couldn't open a payment page for your account, so nothing was charged. If it happens again, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.buy-unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached, so no payment page opened. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-account again.

ev-account.buy-other.say: Evalation couldn't open a payment page just now, so nothing was charged. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.
